chunks: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
It is not correct for the woman that her paternal uncle marries her, nor her maternal uncle, from the breast-feeding.
ai.seo_question: Who are the uncles prohibited from marrying a woman due to breast-feeding?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the prohibition of marriage extends to the maternal and paternal uncles via breast-feeding (radāʿ), mirroring the status of blood relatives. In Shia jurisprudence, this establishes that the nursing relationship creates a permanent mahram bond, rendering these uncles ineligible for marriage just as direct ancestors are. This ruling underscores the comprehensive nature of radāʿ in defining family structure and marital eligibility within the Shi'a legal tradition.
